verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shortcut exposing its workspace to external agents, through an MCP server and connections to Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI. Nothing documents a built-in AI assistant inside Shortcut that users can delegate tasks to. Connecting outside agents is an adjacent integration, not the in-product assistant this story asks for, and the 'idea to spec to PR' marketing line does not describe one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
